description.en: Taken from the printed row: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists B500S-83D at 7.5 kW, 380 V, two-stage structure pump, manual / electric, vertical 5 m, horizontal 5 m, sand and small stone 5–16 mm, 915 × 550 × 550 mm and 280 kg. Taken from the printed row: The boom note says a short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Keep this cell as published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The page does not print a vertical distance. Read it in the Xingtai table. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. Taken from the printed row: It is not a Pinjin contract record. Keep this cell as published. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
description.zh: 这是有电网、走管道的建筑浇筑。两个已印距离都是 5 m，材料格是砂与小石 5–16 mm。它不是长管路用的拖泵。河北品锦机械（邢台）把B500S-83D列为7.5 kW、380 V、两级结构泵、手动 / 电动、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、砂与小石 5–16 mm、外形 915 × 550 × 550 mm、280 kg。臂架说明是本机短臂架，不是车载布料杆。不要把同一工况挪到电动10系列，那一行印的是15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m、骨料 2 cm 及以下、料斗 0.1 m³、外形 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。这一页没有印垂直距离。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
